newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aware Inc started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aware Inc started at buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Joe Noel has started coverage of Aware Inc with a buy rating.
-- In a statement, Noel said the company's Discrete MultiTone modulation technology will become a widely adopted technology in the telecommunications arena.
-- He said much of Aware's revenue in future periods will come from very high margin software/technology licensing fees.

-- He expects Aware to generate a 1996 net profit of $0.02/shr on sales of $5.41 million, a 1997 net loss of $0.11/shr on sales of $12.74 million and a 1998 net profit of $0.31/shr on sales of $40.1 million.
